shortDescription: Module to manage vNIC profile of network in oVirt/RHV

options.name: auth
options.description: Dictionary with values needed to create HTTP/HTTPS connection to oVirt:

options.name: custom_properties
options.description: Custom properties applied to the vNIC profile. Custom properties is a list of dictionary which can have following values:

options.name: description
options.description: A human-readable description in plain text.

options.name: fetch_nested
options.description: If I(True) the module will fetch additional data from the API. It will fetch IDs of the VMs disks, snapshots, etc. User can configure to fetch other attributes of the nested entities by specifying C(nested_attributes).

options.name: migratable
options.description: Marks whether pass_through NIC is migratable or not.

options.name: name
options.description: A human-readable name in plain text.

options.name: nested_attributes
options.description: Specifies list of the attributes which should be fetched from the API. This parameter apply only when C(fetch_nested) is I(true).

options.name: network
options.description: Name of network to which is vNIC attached.

options.name: network_filter
options.description: The network filter enables to filter packets send to/from the VM's nic according to defined rules.

options.name: pass_through
options.description: Enables passthrough to an SR-IOV-enabled host NIC. When enabled C(qos) and  C(network_filter) are automatically set to None and C(port_mirroring) to False. When enabled and C(migratable) not specified then C(migratable) is enabled. Port mirroring, QoS and network filters are not supported on passthrough profiles.

options.name: poll_interval
options.description: Number of the seconds the module waits until another poll request on entity status is sent.

options.name: qos
options.description: Quality of Service attributes regulate inbound and outbound network traffic of the NIC.

options.name: timeout
options.description: The amount of time in seconds the module should wait for the instance to get into desired state.

options.name: wait
options.description: C(yes) if the module should wait for the entity to get into desired state.
